what: FYI for 01067: `blaze pack -p PACKAGE --out PATH [cargo flags]`, run in the project dir (or with --manifest-path), replaces `blaze-wasm pack`. It checks PACKAGE for wasm32-unknown-unknown --release (debug_assertions off; --target/--release/--profile are refused), runs its build scripts and proc macros sandboxed, then writes serde_json of blaze_wasm_pack::record(...) to PATH; the program is the package's one binary, else its library. Agent API: Request::Pack { view, targets, program } -> Response::Packed { pack } (SCHEMA 15). build-dioxus.sh can call it once the coordinator's check of it is green.
